# WPS AI

> WPS AI is the suite-wide Office Copilot inside free WPS Office — agentic AI for writing, slides, sheets, PDF, and photos.

WPS AI is the AI layer in WPS Office (also called WPS / Kingsoft Office), not a separate suite. One assistant covers Writer, Spreadsheet, Presentation, and PDF: draft and rewrite, generate decks, analyze data, and chat with documents.

Key terms: WPS AI, Office Copilot, agentic AI, AI Writing, Slide Designer, Data Analyst, Chat PDF, AI Summarizer, Writer, Spreadsheet, Presentation, WPS PDF, Photos, AirPage, AirSheet, Forms, DBSheet, free WPS Office

## Product

- [WPS AI Home](https://www.wps.ai/en-US/): Official homepage — WPS AI Office Copilot and free office download
- [WPS AI Features](https://www.wps.ai/en-US/wps-ai-features/): Official directory of suite-wide AI capabilities
- [Download WPS Office](https://www.wps.ai/en-US/download/): Free installers for Windows, Mac, Linux, iPad, iOS, Android

## AI capabilities (as on the homepage)

- [Office Copilot](https://www.wps.ai/en-US/wps-ai-features/#intl-ai-group-copilot): Suite-wide Copilot — AI Writing, Slide Designer, Data Analyst, PDF AI Reader
- [Docs AI](https://www.wps.ai/en-US/wps-ai-features/#intl-ai-group-writer): Draft, rewrite, and summarize in Writer
- [Sheets AI](https://www.wps.ai/en-US/wps-ai-features/#intl-ai-group-spreadsheet): Plain-language formulas and data insights
- [Slides AI](https://www.wps.ai/en-US/wps-ai-features/#intl-ai-group-presentation): Outline-to-deck and topic-to-slides
- [PDF AI](https://www.wps.ai/en-US/wps-ai-features/#intl-ai-group-pdf): Chat PDF and PDF summarizer
- [Photos AI](https://www.wps.ai/en-US/wps-ai-features/#intl-ai-group-photos): AI photo editor and background remover

## Proof & trust (homepage facts)

- 600 million monthly active users; 672 million monthly active devices (as of March 2026, WPS about page)
- Available in 220+ countries & regions; 46 languages; 200,000+ enterprise customers
